text:
Foxborough, Massachusetts dị na Greater Boston metropolitan area, ihe dị ka maịl 22 (35 km) n’ebe ndịda ọdịda anyanwụ nke ogbe etiti Boston na ihe dị ka maịl 18 (29 km) n’ebe ugwu ọwụwa anyanwụ nke Providence, Rhode Island. E biri na ya na 1704 ma tinye ya n’ọrụ na 1778, aha ya sitere na Charles James Fox, onye British Whig MP kwadoro ndị America. Taa, Foxborough bụ ebe a maara nke ọma maka Gillette Stadium, ebe egwuregwu na ntụrụndụ nke, ya na Patriot Place dị nso, ndị Kraft Group nwere.

Omenala bọọlụ ebe a abụghị nke obere obodo Foxborough kama nke Greater Boston metro gbara ya gburugburu. Boston bụ nnukwu ahịa egwuregwu America, ndị otu abụọ na-ekerịta ụlọ egwuregwu ahụ: New England Patriots nke NFL na New England Revolution nke MLS. E hiwere Revolution n’etiti klọb iri mbụ nke MLS site n’aka Robert Kraft na 1996 ma kpọọ ya aha maka ọrụ mpaghara ahụ n’oge American Revolution.

Mgbọrọ bọọlụ nke mpaghara ahụ dị omimi karịa. Oneida Football Club nke Boston, nke e hiwere na 1862, bụ klọb bọọlụ izizi a haziri ahazi na United States. Ihe nketa ahụ gara n’ihu ruo oge a site n’ụlọ egwuregwu gara aga, Foxboro Stadium, nke mere egwuregwu na 1994 FIFA World Cup na 1999 Women’s World Cup. Gillette Stadium agbakwunyela na ya site na ịnabata 2003 Women’s World Cup, 2016 Copa America Centenario, na ọtụtụ Gold Cups — ihe ndekọ mere akụkụ a nke New England otu n’ime ebe bọọlụ kacha ama na mba ahụ.
